description: El Paso Central Appraisal District. The host blocks automated clients. See docs/registry/sources/tx-elpaso-cad.md.

sources.ai_use: Restricted: the AUP lists AI training data collection among prohibited activities; robots.txt Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference; a list of named AI crawlers is disallowed, the FactLot bot is not named. The registry does not train models on source data
sources.notes: Gated on terms; nothing was downloaded. epcad.org/OpenGovernment lists (read by the collector on 2026-11-03; plain curl gets a Cloudflare challenge, the collector's identified client does not): 2026 Certified Export Files (export.epcad.org, 408,260,829 bytes, 2026-10-13) in the True Automation Appraisal Export Layout 8.0.34 (layout zip 92,947 bytes; the family Travis and Tarrant use, so the tx_travis adapter will probably read it, unconfirmed); REAL_ESTATE.zip (168,080,334 bytes), APPRAISAL_ROLL.zip (122,338,947), PERSONAL_PROPERTY.zip; weekly Property Search dumps on propertysearch.blob.core.windows.net (Properties2027Dump.zip 21,830,459 bytes, Owners2027Dump.zip 15,301,442, plus Deeds, Improvements, Lands, Rolls, TaxJurisdictions, Values; tilde-delimited flat files with a Schemas.txt of 3,365 bytes); GIS parcels2026.zip (86,532,772 bytes, attributes without values). The AUP also forbids excessive or automated Property Search queries, which the collector does not make. robots.txt: Allow / for generic agents, Disallow /Account /Search /Property/ /Kiosk/ /Iaao/. Action: a person decides whether weekly downloads of the official export files fall under AUP section 2.2, or asks EPCAD (webmaster listed on the site) for written authorization; then set verified true.
sources.license: Public record. The EPCAD disclaimer says all information is 'considered in the public domain' and is distributed without warranty. Website Acceptable Use Policy (epcad.org/AcceptableUsePolicy) section 1.2 prohibits bots, crawlers and scrapers, 'AI training data collection' and bulk extraction without prior written authorization; section 2.2 says users who need bulk data should use the official datasets and export files on the Open Government page
sources.redistribution: Not addressed beyond 'public domain'; confidential owners are not identified in what was read
